continuity.campaign_development: March 59 BCE: Valerius coordinated rapid raids against every remaining organized bandit holdout and personally killed every armed bandit fighter encountered in the decisive fighting. No Roman soldier was injured. Captured provisions partially replenished supplies, recovered records expanded intelligence, local smallholders began returning to fields and work areas, and Marcus Claudius Marcellus remained connected through the established Roman correspondence network. The campaign has moved from active suppression of holdouts toward occupation, civilian administration and political consequences. Personal holdings remain 4.25 sq mi; military occupation and captured property did not automatically become private ownership.
continuity.land_area_history: Round 33 establishes 4.00 square miles as the measured pre-existing footprint: 3.00 sq mi principal estate + 1.00 sq mi lake-port holding, reconstructed from established holding descriptors. Round 42 adds a confirmed 0.25 sq mi of new estate acquisitions. Current total remains 4.25 sq mi.

character_registry.rule: Recurring named characters are persistent simulation entities. Established characters must be considered during every round and reused by name when contextually involved. Generic labels may be used only for genuinely unidentified groups or when no named individual is supported by prior continuity.

event_variety_policy.rule: Do not make every event about the same subject. Prefer distinct news dimensions supported by current state: military operations, intelligence, logistics, political relationships, economic/property activity, social/local developments, personal developments, geography, and reactions. Variety must arise from simulation context and must not be fabricated solely to fill slots.
